challenge: Cool morning (~50°F) warming to a sunny-ish, dry ~66°F afternoon with light wind. Keep it easy-to-moderate today.
items: Easy 10 min stretch to start the day
Easy 50 min walk early-to-mid afternoon (~63–66°F, light wind)
Total Gym upper, moderate: 3 x 10 rows, 3 x 10 chest press, 2 x 10 pull-ups, nothing to failure
20 min easy kayak late afternoon if the lake is calm, dress for cold water (optional)
